verdict.rationale: GitBook's own docs include a 'Reusable content' page, which points to a first-party snippet capability. The evidence is only a page title, though, with no description of how edits propagate across pages, and variables are not evidenced at all. Content variants (docs-20) is a different feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented sync behavior for reusable blocks across pages, variables support, usage details or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical writer, reusable snippets and variables keep repeated content in sync across pages
